question:
In a family, there are 6 members P, Q, R, S, T and U. P and Q are a married couple

 R is the son of P 

T is the sister of R 

Q is the mother of S 

U is the brother of P

Who is the father of S?
solution:
From the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b336de92e5e5bdd4d616a91cee7d417954570e00d307363e996887d78144906d.png] 

Based on given data, we can draw the family tree-

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65f4bb437a1793d53d931eb2b69aa1950f08b827cffabeafed7d05247db2d598.png] 

From the diagram, R,T and S are the children of P.

So P is the Father of S.

Hence correct **Option 1.**
